Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
This is a deck that I've played several iterations of in tournaments, but that has never won. Nevertheless, I think it is a good deck and worth publishing now that I'm retiring it.

Deck Name: FoS Aggression
Author: Brandon Haas
Description: Bring out Amenophobis and about two smaller vampires (preferably not spending more than another 8 pool). Bleed with Eternal Mask. It doesn't really matter if opponents try to block you or not because as long as some of your actions get through successfully, whether the bleed is successful or not, you get to cycle an extra card thanks to Amenopophobis's special. Using his special it can seem like you have a lot more defense than you really do. Marked Path was a later addition to the deck, one which I think synergizes well with Amenophobis's special because it is in the same window and you can choose the order.

This is as close to the final decklist as I have, I already took apart the deck. I think there might have been a Direct Intervention in there, possibly along with ~two WWEF. Wash is very useful in this deck for three reasons:

1) Cancel pool gain or combos of your prey
2) It doesn't take a full MPA
3) You don't need to have 7 cards since you hardly react

The major weakness of the deck is rush combat. Intercept decks aren't too bit a deal as long as you only face one on a given table. If they have time to tool-up with the Bowl of Convergence, intercept locations, etc., then they are hard to get past. It is not uncommon to get 5 stealth on a bleed action.

Anyway, try the deck for yourself if you want, see what you think.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I don't think Ahmose is that much better than Allonzo Montoya here.

There's quite a lot of stealth in this deck.
I also think there should be more pool <=> blood conversion (Minion Tap, Blood Doll, Villein, Vessel)

Marked Path is pretty bad.

I suppose that, once they've got that you're a S&B, they'll let you choke on stealth.
There are two things you can do to avoid that:
1 - Add cyclers. More Dreams.
2 - Add smart-ass cards. Elder Impersonation is my favourite.

Finally, 8 Revelation of Desire, and a mere 4 Revelation of Ecstasy / no Cave of Apples?
I'd have more of these Truths of a Thousand Lies and 3-4 Enticement.

Messages.Author: Amenophobis
Messages.Body:
I always try to put Form of Corruption, Temptation and/or Edge Vitiation into my FoS decks.
Form of Corruption often disrupts your prey's play - which is sometimes worth the card slot.
Temptation can be used offensively or defensively on prey or predator. The targeted vampires are often seen hunting, even if not really necessary.
Edge Vitation is a very cool card, totally under-estimated, which is also having a psychological effect on your predator.

Though Revelations of Ecstasy are also useful for tapping nasty blockers, you might consider removing them completely. Revelations of Desire give +1 bleed on normal, that should suffice in the long run.

Have you considered Crocodile Temple for extra annoyance?

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
There used to be other non-bleed actions in the deck, but I took them all out in favor of streamlining it. Every minion should bleed for 2+ at stealth each turn. In this way I've overrun Maris Streck, among other natural foes of stealth bleed.

I've never used Temptation much, it seems too corner-case to me. Maybe I'll think of something I'd like to do with it.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> brandonsantacruz wrote:
> I've never used Temptation much, it seems too corner-case to me. Maybe I'll think of something I'd like to do with it.
>
The base idea is to get a temptation on one of your vampire, so on following turn he can do stealth bleed, then an Enticement. At worst, you store an action in a "calm" turn to better overwhelm your prey ; at best, you entice every turn. (or use the action for any non-bleed interesting action ; other temptation, form of corruption, torpor rescue ...)

Of course, you can also use it, even cross table, when an interesting vampire is low on blood to retrieve action from it.

Vessel help a lot with blood management when you tempt yourself
